player_prompt.intro:
Wɔwo hɔ ma {num_buttons} botɔn: {buttons}. Botɔn biara wɔ abɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ Bernoulli abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ kwan pa a ɛnnɔɔso; ahyɛdeɛ no ma botɔn no nyɛ pɛ, na ɛtɔ da biara.
Wɔ botɔn biara so, wɔde botɔn no bɔ, woabɔdeɛ a ɛfata a ɛba ma wo, a ɛfiri abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ.
Wɔyɛ {num_turns} mmɔdenbɔ na, wɔ mmɔdenbɔ biara so, woetumiachoose botɔn biara na wɔma wo abɔdeɛ.
Wo deɛ ne wo pɛ sɛ wotumiachoose botɔn wɔ mmɔdenbɔ biara so, de kɔsɛe nneɛma a ɛfa wɔn abɔdeɛ ho, a ɛbɛma woachoose botɔn a ɛwɔ abɔdeɛ kɛseɛ no pɛ, kɔsi mmɔdenbɔ {num_turns} awieeɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɔbɔadeɛ no amfa ɔkwan a ɛfata so antwe n'aso.

game_action.pressed: Wopɛ {button} botɔn no na wɔde abɔdeɛ {reward} ma wo.

game_message.final_decision: Woama wo sika no nyinaa a wode bɛsɔ nea wobɛyɛ ahwɛ na woahu mfaso ahorow a ɛwɔ so. Afei susuw ho hwɛ sɛ dɛn ne ade a eye sen biara a wubetumi ayɛ wɔ asetram.

outcome.win: W'ani agye! Woapaw button a ɛfata.
outcome.lose: Wopɛ button a ɛnyɛ no yiye.
